title: Task Scheduler
statement:
Each task is labeled by an uppercase English letter. Execute one task per interval, with any number of idle intervals allowed. The same label must have at least `n` intervals between its executions. Return the minimum number of intervals needed to finish all tasks.

## Examples

```text
Input: tasks = ["A","A","A","B","B","B"], n = 2
Output: 8
```

```text
Input: tasks = ["A","C","A","B","D","B"], n = 1
Output: 6
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= tasks.length <= 10^4`
- Every task is one uppercase English letter
- `0 <= n <= 100`
